craft_notes: Sthāyin: freedom. Sanskrit-first: priye vocative kept as lady. Rows: 2. Close: naught. Rejected: dropping address — killed: Goddess listens. Read aloud: freeing cadence.

lines: Fall is flight; place is naught.
l4.sanskrit_cite: piṇḍapātādayaṃ muktaḥ khecaro vā bhavetpriye | ācārye tattvasaṃpanne yatra tatra mṛte sati
